changelog: Fixed gigabit throughput: tun2socks now uses MTU 9000 jumbo frames (gVisor TCP window 6x larger)
Removed QUIC/UDP-443 block so browsers can use HTTP/3 for maximum download speeds
Removed SOCKS5 sniffing overhead — TUN mode routes by network type, no per-packet deep inspection
Added TCP Fast Open on proxy outbound for lower latency connection establishment
